answer: Use bonded, surprise service audits to make each agent identity costly to maintain. At an unpredictable time, two independent clients send it a fresh basalt image with a fable planted in the sample metadata; the agent must flag the false claim and return a signed classification before a short deadline. Clients compare the echo of its signed result and timing. Every extra fake identity needs its own locked bond and live capacity for simultaneous audits; a missed or contradictory response burns that bond.
